## What's new

**Uploads no longer take your whole line.** Copying many films to a drive used to fill the upload of your internet line, and on DSL games lagged and video calls stuttered meanwhile. Now you decide how fast CryptBridge uploads.

### Windows

- **New on the Settings tab: Uploads.**
  - *Files uploaded at the same time*: 1 to 16. The default stays 4, as before.
  - *Upload speed limit* in MB/s. Empty means no limit, as before. Set it a little below your upload speed: a speed test shows it in Mbit/s, divide by 8 for MB/s (40 Mbit/s is 5 MB/s).
- **Changes take effect at once**, also for uploads that are already running. No reconnecting needed.
- **Downloads are never limited.** Opening files and streaming films, also over the LAN access, always run at full speed. Vaults on this PC or a USB drive are not slowed down either.
- Both values count for all drives and clouds together. See [Upload speed](https://github.com/burnersen/CryptBridge/blob/main/docs/windows-app.md#upload-speed).
- **Google Drive:** the guide now says clearly that your own Google app needs no branding check or verification. If Google complains about the homepage or the privacy policy, ignore it: what counts is *In production* on the Audience page, then sign in again once.
- Your settings, vaults and the app lock stay as they are. rclone stays at 1.75.2.

### Linux server

- Nothing changed. Updating the server is not needed.

## Updating

- **Windows:** quit CryptBridge (wait until no uploads are running), replace `CryptBridge.exe` with the new one and start it. Going back to 0.11 later is possible: it simply ignores the new upload settings.
- **Server:** nothing to do.

## Downloads

- `CryptBridge.exe`: Windows 11 (64-bit), needs [WinFsp](https://winfsp.dev/rel/)
- `setup.sh`: Linux server (Ubuntu / Debian)
- Backup copies (optional, see above): the four rclone ZIP files, `winfsp-2.1.25156.msi`, `rclone-LICENSE.txt`, `WinFsp-LICENSE.txt`
